tools.description: Search the MyEngine index (components, fields, CLI flags, ABI slots, ADRs, engine_spec.md headings, golden screenshots) by English or Japanese words. Returns ranked hits with their source; use describe on a hit id for details. `stale: true` means the index is older than its sources (run tools\gen_engine_index.ps1).

kind.description: Restrict to these kinds. Omit for all.

tools.name: search

tools.description: Look up one id exactly (component name, Component.field, CLI flag, ABI slot name, ADR-NNN, spec heading, golden name). Returns all matches across kinds: component fields, mentioning spec headings / ADRs (up to 20 each, with mentionsTotal), related goldens. Unknown ids return the top 5 candidates.

id.description: Exact id as returned by search.

tools.name: describe

tools.description: Run one tools\replay_verify.bat job (prebuilt Debug and Release Editor.exe required; nothing is built) in the background and read its structured result. op=start returns a jobId; op=poll returns running or, when done, exitCode plus a summary (failed stage, first mismatching tick, diagnostic lines; not the whole log). At most 2 jobs run at once and a job name cannot be started twice at the same time.

job.description: op=start: the job name (the :job_* labels of replay_verify.bat).

jobId.description: op=poll: the jobId returned by start.

tools.name: verify_job

tools.description: Read the project's append-only notes (.mye/notes/<topic>.md, gitignored; the engine index is separate). Omit topic to list topics ([{topic, bytes, lastHeading}] in name order). With topic, returns the latest `latest` entries (default 5, max 50) oldest first; the entries are capped at 64 KB measured as JSON-escaped heading + text (oldest entries are dropped, truncated: true).

topic.description: Topic name. Omit to list topics.

tools.name: note_read

tools.description: Append one entry to a topic (created on first use) as `## <UTC time> <title>` followed by the text. Append-only: entries cannot be edited, overwritten or deleted. Returns the relative path and the file size after the append. Use for the current state of work that should survive the session; not for facts that belong in docs or ADRs.

topic.description: Topic name (letters, digits, _ and -; Windows device names such as con / nul / com1 are refused).

tools.name: note_append

tools.description: Start an AI change-tracking session for this project before you edit files (the tracking service is started if it is not running). Returns a sessionId; pass it to change_report and change_session_end. Sessions are optional: edits are recorded either way, a session only lets them be attributed to you.

clientSessionId.description: Your own stable session id; beginning again with the same id resumes the session.

isolated.description: true if you work in a dedicated git worktree.

workspace.description: Directory you work in (default: the project root).

tools.name: change_session_begin

tools.description: End a change-tracking session when your edits are done. Returns the session status and changeCount (the changes recorded for it).
tools.name: change_session_end

tools.description: After editing, report the files you changed. The service compares your report with what it observed on disk and answers per path: matched, mismatch or not_observed, plus the attribution. A report alone never makes a change `verified` (it stays `claimed`); hashes are optional (without them the result is mismatch). Begin a session first, edit, then report.

afterHashes.description: Optional SHA-256 of each file after your edit, same shape as beforeHashes (null = deleted).

beforeHashes.description: Optional SHA-256 of each file before your edit: an array in the order of paths, or an object keyed by path (null = did not exist).

operationId.description: Optional operationId to tie the report to.

paths.description: Changed files (project-relative or absolute, inside the project).

tools.name: change_report

tools.description: List recorded changes (newest first), optionally for one session, path (a trailing / matches a prefix), time range (UTC milliseconds), review state, attribution or change type. Returns items and nextCursor (pass it as cursor for the next page). Blobs and hunk bodies are never included. If coverage.baselining is true the list may be incomplete.
tools.name: change_list

tools.description: Describe one recorded change by revisionId (from change_list): before / after hashes and sizes, hunk summaries (line ranges, not bodies), attribution with its evidence, restorability. The hunks and evidence are capped at 64 KB in total (truncated: true when cut).
